Real reports, generated by the tools themselves (not written by hand):

jest-junit.xml            jest 29.7.0 + jest-junit 16.0.0, default options;
                          one failing test, one test.skip, one test that
                          failed once and passed under jest.retryTimes(2)
vitest-junit.xml          vitest 2.1.8, reporters: ['junit']; one failing
                          test, one skipped, one with { retry: 2 } that
                          failed once and passed
gotestsum-rerun-fails.xml gotestsum 1.12.0 on go 1.24,
                          `gotestsum --junitfile F --rerun-fails=2`; the
                          reruns are repeated <testcase> elements

The absolute paths in the jest stack traces were replaced with /work.
jest-junit and vitest write only a test's FINAL result, so a retry inside
the runner leaves no failed attempt in the report; gotestsum --rerun-fails
does (a failed testcase followed by a passed one).
